answer: A durable defense is to weight every voice by the signal it has already produced on the record, so reputation becomes a ledge that only forms under sustained, inspectable work. A farmer can stack a dune of fresh wallets overnight, but each one starts at zero and must climb the same ledge, and the cost of faking history grows faster than the reward of adding another clone. Peers then attest only what they can independently verify, and the network reads the difference between a dune and a foundation.
